# Toggle

> Pressed-state button and toggle group built on the Button surface.

This file matches the installed `toggle` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/toggle.json
```

With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/toggle.md`.

## npm dependencies

- `@base-ui/react@^1.9.0`

## Registry dependencies

- `button`
- `core`
- `track-highlight`

## Exports

- `@/components/control-ui/ui/toggle`: `Toggle`, `ToggleGroup`, types `ToggleProps`, `ToggleGroupProps`

## Composition

### Single toggle

```tsx
<Toggle />
```

### Toggle group

```tsx
<ToggleGroup>
  <Toggle />
</ToggleGroup>
```

## Usage

```tsx
"use client";

import { BoldIcon, ItalicIcon, UnderlineIcon } from "lucide-react";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { useState } from "react";
import { Toggle, ToggleGroup } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/toggle";
import { Text } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/typography";

function Row({ label, children }: { label: string; children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
      <Text size="caption" weight="medium" tone="muted">
        {label}
      </Text>
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}

export function PrimitiveToggleExample() {
  const [pinned, setPinned] = useState(false);
  const [format, setFormat] = useState<string[]>(["bold"]);
  const [view, setView] = useState<string[]>(["grid"]);

  return (
    <div className="flex w-full max-w-sm flex-col gap-6">
      <Row label="Single toggle">
        <Toggle pressed={pinned} onPressedChange={setPinned}>
          {pinned ? "Pinned" : "Pin"}
        </Toggle>
      </Row>

      <Row label="Multi-select group">
        <ToggleGroup multiple value={format} onValueChange={setFormat} aria-label="Text formatting">
          <Toggle value="bold" aria-label="Bold">
            <BoldIcon />
          </Toggle>
          <Toggle value="italic" aria-label="Italic">
            <ItalicIcon />
          </Toggle>
          <Toggle value="underline" aria-label="Underline">
            <UnderlineIcon />
          </Toggle>
        </ToggleGroup>
      </Row>

      <Row label="Single-select group">
        <ToggleGroup value={view} onValueChange={setView} aria-label="View mode">
          <Toggle value="grid">Grid</Toggle>
          <Toggle value="list">List</Toggle>
          <Toggle value="board">Board</Toggle>
        </ToggleGroup>
      </Row>

      <Row label="Disabled">
        <Toggle pressed disabled>
          Locked
        </Toggle>
      </Row>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Anatomy

Scopes, their parts, and the state attributes each part carries. Selector pattern: `[data-skin="{skin}"] :where([data-slot="{part}"][data-control-family="{family}"])`.

- `toggle`
  - `check`
  - `content`
  - `group`: `data-disabled`, `data-multiple`, `data-orientation` (`horizontal` | `vertical`), `data-track` (`hover` | `none`)
  - `root`: `data-active`, `data-icon-only`, `data-layout` (`inline` | `tile`), `data-shape` (`circle` | `default`), `data-size` (`lg` | `md` | `sm` | `xs`), `data-tone` (`danger` | `neutral` | `primary`), `data-variant` (`dashed` | `ghost` | `link` | `quiet` | `scrim` | `solid` | `surface`)
